what: Association and Sequential Rule Mining for Temporal Event Data
title: Association and Sequential Rule Mining for Temporal Event Data
text: Association sequential rule mining temporal event data, clean-room base R. Event data — learning traces, coded interactions, clickstreams — arrives log , . dynarules mines two kinds rules : Co-occurrence rules (plan, discuss => reflect): actions appear together transaction, order ignored. Level-wise Apriori full candidate pruning. Sequential rules (plan -> discuss => reflect): ordered patterns predict comes later. Generalized sequential pattern mining; support non-contiguous subsequence containment.

title: Association and Sequential Rule Mining for Temporal Event Data
text: dynarules clean-room base-R implementation, wrapper. measures, condensed itemset targets, redundancy significance predicates pinned arules numerically equivalence suite, transaction grammar, sequential mining inference verbs arules counterpart. Three definitional differences deliberate: dynarules generates multi-item consequents (arules::apriori emits single-item ones ); never produces empty-antecedent rules; window_size correspond arulesSequences’ maxwin, window parity claimed. Unconstrained sequential mining gap = 1 match cspade() exactly sequence-vs-transaction counting aligned. Part Dynalytics R family alongside Nestimate (network estimation) psychnets (psychometric networks).

what: Convert Mined Rules to a Plottable Network — as_network
title: Convert Mined Rules to a Plottable Network — as_network
text: Builds item-level directed network rule set: nodes items, rule contributes edges every antecedent item every consequent item. Parallel edges (item pair reached several rules) aggregated. result mirrors Nestimate / cograph netobject layout carries cograph_network class, plots directly cograph::splot(net).

title: Convert Mined Rules to a Plottable Network — as_network
code: as_network(   x,   weight = "lift",   aggregate = c("max", "mean", "sum"),   top = NULL,   directed = NULL,   level = c("item", "rule"),   size_by = "support",   palette = "sequential",   layout = "spring",   label_rules = FALSE,   node_size_range = c(4, 15),   edge_width = 0.5,   edge_alpha = 1 )

title: Convert Mined Rules to a Plottable Network — as_network
text: x dynarules object. weight Character. rule metric becomes edge weight: measure list_measures(), e.g. "lift" (default), "confidence", "support", "kappa". aggregate Character. parallel edges combine: "max" (default), "mean", "sum". top Integer NULL. Use top N rules lift. directed Logical NULL. NULL (default) decides data: sequential rules always directed, co-occurrence rules directed chosen weight asymmetric. Confidence, conviction Laplace accuracy asymmetric; lift, support, kappa, jaccard, cosine, phi leverage symmetric, lift-weighted co-occurrence network undirected. Pass TRUE/FALSE override. level "item" (default) collapses rules item--item edges: compact, centrality community analysis wants. "rule" gives one node per rule, antecedent items pointing consequent items – standard association-rule graph. keeps conjunction "item" loses: "item", {,b} => c indistinguishable two rules => c b => c. size_by level = "rule", measure driving rule-node size. Default "support". palette level = "rule", node colour ramp: "sequential" (default), "diverging" (centred independence weight lift-like), "greys", vector colours. layout level = "rule", layout. "spring" (default) "gephi_fr" force layouts suit graph shape. "ring" also available: places items outer circle rule centroid items links. label_rules level = "rule", write rule nodes. FALSE (default) leaves bare, association-rule convention: node's meaning size, colour position. "id" (TRUE) numbers R1, R2, ... can looked rules(). "weight" "size" print value driving channel, "" prints , "rule" prints rule . character vector, one per rule, sets labels directly. node_size_range level = "rule", smallest largest rule-node size. Default c(4, 15). edge_width level = "rule", edge thickness. single value draws every edge width. Default 0.5, .e. thin. edge_alpha level = "rule", edge opacity. Default 1; cograph's default 0.8 leaves edges looking hazy.

title: Convert Mined Rules to a Plottable Network — as_network

what: Mine Association or Sequential Rules — dynarules
title: Mine Association or Sequential Rules — dynarules
text: single entry point rule mining. type = "cooccurrence" mines classic association rules (level-wise Apriori full candidate pruning): order within transaction ignored. type = "sequential" mines order-aware rules (generalized sequential patterns): rule plan -> discuss => reflect states transactions containing plan followed (necessarily immediately) discuss tend contain reflect . Accepts ready transactions() object, raw data plus event-log grammar arguments, forwarded transactions().

text: Tests rule's lift explicit null. co-occurrence rules null item independence: item column transaction matrix permuted independently, preserving every item's frequency destroying co-occurrence. sequential rules null order-irrelevance: events within transaction shuffled, preserving exactly items co-occur destroying order – significant sequential rule informative beyond co-occurrence. title: Construct Transactions from Event Data — transactions
text: data Input data. One : long event log data.frame one row per event; requires action, optionally actor, time, session. wide data.frame One row per transaction, columns consecutive actions (V1, V2, ...); leave action unset. list element ordered character vector actions (one transaction). binary matrix Rows transactions, columns items. Set form : sequential mining unavailable input. actor Character NULL. Column name(s) identifying produced event (long input ). Multiple columns combined. action Character NULL. Column name action/state/code (long input ). Supplying action selects long event-log path. time Character NULL. Column name timestamps used order events within actor stream. NULL, input row order kept. session Character NULL. Column name(s) identifying session event belongs (long input ). unit Character. one transaction : "session" (actor x session; default), "actor" (actor's full stream), "window" (consecutive-event windows within actor stream). window Integer. Window width events (unit = "window" ). step Integer NULL. Window step; NULL means tumbling windows (step = window). weights Optional numeric vector transaction weights, one per transaction, weighted support. NULL (default) weights every transaction equally.

title: dynarules 0.5.0
text: discretize() now discretize_items(). bare name collided arules::discretize() tsn::discretize() – tsn’s different operation different input shape (long time-series data, fifteen methods, states rather items), masking actively confusing. new name also says verb . dynarules now collides name cograph, Nestimate tsn.

title: dynarules 0.5.0
text: dynarules() gains gap, min_gap window_size sequential mining: maximum minimum number events consecutive items pattern, maximum span pattern’s first item last. Gaps counted events, clock time. containment matcher now backtracks. Unconstrained, greedy first-match scan exact; maximum gap , committing earliest occurrence can strand rest pattern past limit later occurrence matched. constrained path carries full set reachable positions instead. Verified brute-force enumeration every embedding: 4000 random trials, zero disagreements. Mining maximum gap disables drop-one subsequence prune, valid constraint: dropping item middle pattern widens gap neighbours, frequent pattern can infrequent drop-one subsequence. GSP join unaffected, since dropping first last item never widens interior gap.

title: dynarules 0.5.0
text: rule_induction() regenerates rules patterns already mined, new confidence, lift, length appearance thresholds, without re-running miner. Output identical re-mining, rule types. min_support lowered way – patterns original threshold never counted.

title: dynarules 0.5.0
text: cba() builds classifier class association rules using CBA M1 algorithm (Liu, Hsu & Ma 1998): rules sorted precedence reduced ordered decision list, keeping rule correctly classifies case already covered, default class cut-chosen minimise total error. predict() dynarules_cba returns predicted classes, type = "rule" index rule fired. print() summary() methods show decision list.

title: dynarules 0.5.0
text: Unconstrained sequential mining gap = 1 match arulesSequences::cspade() exactly, definitions aligned (cspade counts sequences, dynarules counts transactions). window_size correspond cspade’s maxwin, constant offset aligns . dynarules therefore makes window-parity claim; definition brute-force-verified one .

title: dynarules 0.4.0
text: Networks rendered cograph. plot(type = "graph") hands object cograph::splot() meta$splot producer contract instead drawing layout. grid dependency gone. as_network() gains level = "rule", standard association-rule graph one node per rule. keeps conjunction item-level collapse loses: level = "item", {,b} => c indistinguishable => c plus b => c. as_network() accepts 50 interest measures weight. Directedness derived rather assumed. Sequential rules always directed; co-occurrence rules weight asymmetric. Confidence, conviction Laplace accuracy asymmetric; lift, support, kappa, jaccard, cosine, phi leverage symmetric, lift-weighted co-occurrence network undirected. rule_key() draws size colour key rule-level network.

title: dynarules 0.3.0
text: Transaction layer: item_frequency(), cross_table(), affinity(), support_of(), sample_transactions(), random_transactions(), add_complement(), aggregate_items(), read_transactions(). discretize_items() numeric vectors data.frames, frequency, interval, cluster fixed methods. Weighted support: transactions(weights =) dynarules(weights =). Support becomes share total weight rather transactions. Verified arules: weighted support matches weclat(), transaction verbs match arules counterparts, discretize_items() matches four methods.
